name: Indic Karaoke
notes: Indic shaping: burn via ffmpeg's ass= filter (libass + HarfBuzz does OpenType shaping). If glyphs ever render unshaped, append :shaping=complex to the filter; ship fonts in ./fonts and pass fontsdir=./fonts — libass fontconfig fallback covers any glyph Mukta lacks. Group only on ASR whitespace tokens, never split a token (research/06 §5.2 rule 6).
